name: Kulfa
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

sources.citation: Keegan, John M. & Koutou Koyombo Prosper. [2014]. Dictionary of Sara Kaba Na (with English introduction). Cuenca: Morkeg Books. 332 pp. [closest described relative; Keegan 2015 p. v: Kulfa phonology 'very similar to that of Sara Kaba Na']
sources.note: Nothing on stress; tone-based description (checked as a proxy only; not Kulfa).

sources.citation: Keegan, John M., Nanga Jean Tadio & Ndoko Masa Singa. 2015. Kulfa Lexicon: Kulfa-French, French-Kulfa. 1st ed. (Oct. 2015). Cuenca: Morkeg Books (Sara-Bagirmi Language Project). 109 pp. [supersedes Tadio & Keegan 2014 Petit Lexique Kulfa / Kulfa Word List listed by Glottolog]
sources.note: Nothing. Front matter (pp. i-x): Alphabet with segment values, 1.1 Phonemes, 1.2 inflection described entirely in terms of three level tones (verb tone classes High-Low/Low-Low, Mid-Mid/Low-Mid, High-Mid), 1.3 auxiliaries; tone marked on every entry. The words 'stress'/'accent' do not occur except 'northern/southern accent' (= dialect).

sources.citation: Boyeldieu, Pascal. 2006. Presentation des langues sara-bongo-baguirmiennes (introduction to Boyeldieu, Nougayrol & Palayer, Lexique comparatif historique des langues SBB, CNRS-LLACAN online).
sources.note: Nothing on stress. Kulfa (klf) data source given as 'Fedry (inedit)' = Fedry, J., Questionnaire d'Inventaire Linguistique: kulfa (unpublished ms); Kulfa classed in 'sara peripherique'.

sources.citation: Keegan, John M. Notes on Sara Kaba classification ('Sara Kaba Na is not Sara proper'); Transcription for the Sara Languages; Sara-Bagirmi Bibliography. Morkeg Books project notes.
sources.note: Silent on stress; Kulfa mentioned only re recordings; bibliography lists no further Kulfa titles.
